ShortDescription.Value: [WIP / EXPERIMENTAL] Placeable animated LED screens and billboards that play your own GIFs, images and videos. Back up your saves!

Publish.LongDescription:
## ⚠️ Work in progress: use at your own risk
This mod is an early, **experimental** release. Before using it:
- **Back up your save games.** Keep a copy of any city you place LED screens in. - **Removing the mod later** will remove its screens from saves that contain them. - Updates may still change things, and bugs are possible.
Please report problems on GitHub (link below) with a screenshot and your `Logs/LedScreens.Mod.log`.
---
## What it does
Adds placeable **animated LED screens and digital billboards**. Every screen plays your own media, and each one can show something different.
- **About 95 screens, each with its own icon:** wall screens, posters, ticker strips, **video walls and building facades**, **skyscraper screens** (up to about 67 × 47 m), free-standing billboards, street totems, roadside screens, **high-pole screens** (up to *Mega* and *Ribbon*, plus portrait and **double-sided** versions), round signs, **four-sided screen cubes** (hanging or on a pole), **bridge side screens**, and LED versions of more vanilla props: wall billboard styles, posters, shop signs, hanging and neon-style signs, and the small standing signs (with a **curved** screen that follows the board) - **Media:** animated **GIF**, **PNG/JPG** images and **videos** (MP4, WebM, MOV and more) - **Per-screen controls** in the info panel: media, speed, brightness, LED effect, sync / random start - **Playlists:** cycle through several files **in order** or **shuffled** - **Along roads like trees:** street-level screens can be drawn along a road in Line/Curve mode, filling its tree spots; each one shuffles your media, and the street's panel (click the street name) controls them all, including their **spacing** (every tree spot, or one in 2 to 6) - **Optional LED look:** *Pixelated* or *LED dots* effect, for all screens or per screen - **Live media folder:** new and changed files show up in game within seconds - **Self-lit:** screens keep the same brightness day and night
## How to use
1. **Add your media:** Options → LED Screens → **Open media folder**, then drop in your `.gif`, `.png`, `.jpg` or video files. They show up in game within a few seconds. 2. **Place a screen:** in your city, open **Landscaping → LED Screens** and place one. 3. **Pick what it shows:** **click the screen**. Its info panel has an **LED Screen** section where you choose the media or set up a playlist.
Tip: for smooth video playback, use MP4 (H.264 baseline). See the full guide on GitHub.
## Open source
Free and open source (MIT). Feel free to edit it, build it and contribute: https://github.com/or1995/led-billboards-cs2
Publish.ChangeLog:
0.5.0 (work in progress, experimental: back up your saves) - New: LED Skyscraper Screens for the sides of towers: Tall (34×47 m), Strip (17×63 m), Wide (67×24 m), Mega (67×47 m) and Crown Band (100×8 m) - New: LED Standing Signs (the small rounded vanilla signs), double-sided, with the video curved to follow the board; they can also be drawn along roads - New: LED versions of more vanilla props: wall billboard styles (Small 2-4, Medium 2, Large 2-4), posters (Small to Huge), shop signs, hanging shop signs, neon-style signs and a round shop sign - New: road-side spacing: in the street panel, keep a screen in every tree spot or in one in 2 to 6; a setting sets it for newly lined streets - Road-side screens the game rebuilds (e.g. after a road upgrade) keep the street's media and playlist - Existing screens in your saves are kept
0.4.5 - New: LED Screen Cubes, four screens around a box: hanging (Large / Medium, to put under an arch, gantry or bridge) or on a pole (Large / Medium) - New: LED Bridge Side Screens (16 / 24 / 32 m), double-sided strips to line the sides of a pedestrian bridge at the default 10 m height - Road-side screens can now be controlled: click the street's name, and its panel has an "LED Screens on this street" section that changes all of them - Existing screens in your saves are kept
0.4.0 - Screens along roads: 16 street-level screens can be drawn along a road like trees (Line/Curve mode); they shuffle all your media every 30 s - 7 new double-sided street screens: lamp-post banner, city light poster, sidewalk sign, street ticker, large roadside screen, medium high-pole screen and small round sign on a pole - Free-standing billboards now show the screen on both sides - LED effect per screen (Default / Smooth / Pixelated / LED dots) in the info panel - New and changed media files are picked up automatically, no restart or reload needed - Much faster GIF loading and fewer frame drops: conversion runs in the background, buffers are reused, and only screens you can see load media - Optional disk cache of converted GIFs (Options → Quality) - The "Screen sides" debug option resets to Auto on restart - Existing screens in your saves are kept
